## Page 1
Ripple Attention: A Lightweight Plug-and-Play Channel Attention Block
Jane Doe, John Roe
Example University, Department of Computer Science
Abstract
Channel attention improves convolutional networks, but existing designs are costly. We propose Ripple Attention (RA), a lightweight
plug-and-play module that recalibrates feature maps with a pooled descriptor. RA can be easily inserted into any convolutional
backbone without changing the surrounding layers. Experiments on classification and detection show consistent gains.
1 Introduction
Convolutional backbones benefit from re-weighting channels. In this paper we introduce the Ripple Attention module, which
costs fewer parameters than prior blocks and can be integrated into existing networks.
## Page 2
3 Method
Given an input feature map X of size B x C x H x W, the Ripple Attention block first applies global average pooling to obtain a
descriptor z of shape B x C x 1 x 1. The descriptor is passed through a one-dimensional convolution with kernel size k.
z = GAP(X)                                                        (1)
w = sigmoid(Conv1D(z))                                            (2)
Y = X * w + X                                                     (3)
Figure 2 illustrates the structure of the proposed Ripple Attention module. The output Y has the same shape as the input X, so the
block is a drop-in replacement for identity connections. Algorithm 1 gives the pseudo-code.
4 Ablation
We ablate the Ripple Attention module by removing the residual connection and by varying the kernel size k.
